products.name: Gentle foaming cleanser
products.how: Wash with lukewarm water and your fingertips, then pat dry. No scrubbing.

products.name: Oil-free moisturizer
products.how: A thin layer after washing, morning and night.

products.name: Face sunscreen SPF 30+
products.how: Last step every morning, even on cloudy days.

products.name: Benzoyl peroxide wash (4–5%)
products.how: Use as your evening wash: lather, leave on for about a minute, rinse. Can bleach towels and pillowcases.

products.name: Adapalene 0.1% gel
products.how: A pea-sized amount over the whole face on dry skin at night, then moisturizer.
products.note: Dryness and mild irritation are common in the first weeks. Not for use while pregnant: check with a doctor.

products.name: Salicylic acid 2% cleanser
products.how: Use as your evening wash, then moisturizer.

experiments.name: Pause cow’s milk
experiments.how: Skip cow’s milk (drinks, cereal milk, milky coffee) for 4 weeks, then have it again for 2 weeks. Cheese and yogurt can stay.
experiments.evidence: May help some people. The evidence for milk is weaker and mostly observational.

experiments.name: Lower-sugar swaps
experiments.how: For 8 weeks, swap sugary drinks, white bread and sweets for water, whole grains and fruit.
experiments.evidence: May help some people. The evidence for low-glycemic eating is moderate.

habits: Change one product at a time.
Give a treatment 6 to 8 weeks before judging it. Full clearing often takes 3 to 4 months.
Wash twice a day and after sweating. Don’t scrub.
Try not to pick or pop spots.
